p.src: Overview: Grand unification becomes concrete when the Standard Model group is embedded in $SU(5)$. To see what that statement means, we first build the necessary representation theory: the defining representation $N$, its conjugate $\overline N$, tensor products, symmetric and antisymmetric tensors, and the adjoint. One Standard Model family then falls into the unexpectedly economical combination $\overline{\mathbf 5}\oplus\mathbf{10}$. The same symmetry that makes this arrangement beautiful also requires colored gauge bosons that convert quarks into leptons. Their exchange permits proton decay, forcing the unification scale toward $10^{15}$–$10^{16}\,\mathrm{GeV}$. The running gauge couplings point toward a similar scale, and supersymmetry returns at the end because it makes their numerical meeting substantially sharper.

The $SU(2)$ associated with ordinary angular momentum is closely related to rotations of three-dimensional space. More precisely, $SU(2)$ is the double cover of $SO(3)$. Its irreducible representations are labeled by $j=0,\frac12,1,\frac32,\ldots,
\qquad
\dim(j)=2j+1.$ Thus a scalar is a singlet, a spin-$\tfrac12$ particle is a doublet, and a spin-one particle is a triplet. The weak group $SU(2)_L$ is a different physical symmetry, although its abstract group theory is the same.

p.src:
For $SU(N)$, the defining representation is the space of complex $N$-component columns, $\psi=
\begin{pmatrix}
\psi_1\\
\psi_2\\
\vdots\\
\psi_N
\end{pmatrix},
\qquad
\psi'_i=U_i{}^j\psi_j,
\qquad
U\in SU(N).$ It is called either the defining representation or simply $\mathbf N$. The matrices $U$ are $N\times N$, and the vector space on which they act has dimension $N$.

p.src: The lasting lesson is a tension rather than a verdict. The group theory fits quarks and leptons together with remarkable economy, the running couplings hint at a common high scale, and supersymmetry sharpens the numerical hint. The same construction also predicts the dangerous conversion of quarks into leptons. Any successful version must therefore preserve the elegance while keeping the proton stable for an almost inconceivably long time. In the lecture’s closing spirit: may all our protons remain stable.

ja: 永続する教訓は、判決ではなく緊張関係である。群論はクォークとレプトンを驚くべき経済性で一緒に収め、走る結合定数は共通の高いスケールをほのめかし、超対称性は数値的なほのめかしを鋭くする。同じ構成はまた、クォークがレプトンへと危険に変換されることを予言する。したがって、成功するあらゆる版は、優雅さを保ちながら、陽子をほとんど想像を絶するほど長い間安定に保たなければならない。講義の締めくくりの精神で言えば、我々の陽子がすべて安定であり続けますように。
zh: 持久的教训是一种张力，而不是一个定论。群论以惊人的经济性把夸克和轻子放在一起，跑动耦合暗示着一个共同的高能标，而超对称使这一数值暗示更加鲜明。同样的构造也预言了夸克向轻子的危险转化。因此，任何成功的版本都必须既保持这种优雅，又让质子稳定到几乎不可想象地长久。用讲座的结束精神来说：愿我们所有的质子都保持稳定。
